copy.tagline: 定义AI角色的性格、语气和人格特质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为AI助手或虚拟角色赋予独特个性
copy.tagline_en: Define AI character, voice, and personality traits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to give your AI assistant or virtual character a unique personality

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会按照你定义的人格特征（温暖、专业等）、声音风格（用词、句法）和行为规则来回应，使其拥有稳定一致的个性。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 以特定角色或风格回话时触发，例如“请用导师语气回答”或“表现得活泼一点”。

say.text: 请以一位耐心的导师语气解释这个概念。
say.note: Claude 会模拟导师的温和与鼓励风格。

say.text: 用正式专业的金融顾问口吻分析这笔投资。
say.note: Claude 会切换为严谨专业的词汇和句式。

say.text: 扮演幽默的朋友，用轻松方式讲个道理。
say.note: Claude 会加入幽默元素，但保持边界。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude will respond according to the persona traits (warm, professional, etc.), voice style (word choice, sentence structure), and behavioral rules you define, ensuring a consistent character.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to adopt a specific role or style, such as 'speak like a patient tutor' or 'be more playful'.

say_en.text: Explain this concept in a patient tutor tone.
say_en.note: Claude will adopt a gentle, encouraging style.

say_en.text: Analyze this investment with formal financial advisor language.
say_en.note: Claude will use precise, professional vocabulary.

say_en.text: Tell a lesson in a humorous friend manner.
say_en.note: Claude will add humor while respecting boundaries.
